newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Opel sign three-year-contract with Hingis.
newsitem.headline: Opel sign three-year-contract with Hingis.

text.p: Car company Opel, a subsidiary of General Motors Corp, said on Thursday it had signed a three-year sponsorship deal with Switzerland's 16-year-old Australian Open champion Martina Hingis.
Last month Hingis, the youngest-ever Grand Slam champion in the open era, signed a $10 million contract to promote Italian sportswear label Sergio Tacchini.
Opel did not reveal the sum involved.

The company decided not to renew a 10-year contract with world number one Steffi Graf in October, 1995, worth more than $1 million a year, because of concern about the way her money was being managed.
Graf's father Peter, who had controlled the German's money, was jailed last month for tax evasion.
"Opel already supported us when I was relatively unknown in the world of tennis. This is certainly a good basis for a long-term partnership," Hingis said in a statement.
